== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Responsibility Of Command: the entry “Responsibility Of Command” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 113. Image for [[Responsibility Of Command (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf swccgglossary.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>b3838634d3e1379e527f0914f7816f5b0c130c89</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 113 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a 6-point margin.

SHA-1 <code>d807b4a41ccdf6d2d2657de4707aa83666ab0f0d</code>, SHA-256 <code>ad75a20d9deecfa31f94925f48771aab060008ab1cd493985eb3f2002c3bfd51</code>.
